query: INSERT INTO latest_robot_vacuum_state (device_id, source, current_clean_area, clean_count, attributes) VALUES ($1, 'valetudo', $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (device_id) DO UPDATE SET current_clean_area = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.current_clean_area, latest_robot_vacuum_state.current_clean_area), clean_count = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.clean_count, latest_robot_vacuum_state.clean_count), attributes = EXCLUDED.attributes, updated_at = now()
